title: Train Ticket Resale
scenario: A seller offers sold-out train tickets but wants friends-and-family payment.

answers.A: Send friends-and-family payment to secure the ticket.
answers.B: Use the rail operator official resale or waitlist.
answers.C: Ask the seller for a screenshot of the ticket before paying.
answers.D: Use a protected marketplace that verifies the ticket and seller.

explanation: A screenshot does not prove transfer rights or that the ticket exists. Use the operator or protected resale process.
proTip: A train ticket is only useful if the operator can verify it.
